anomalies.observed: FCC1 VCAP pins (48, 73) are connected to UART3_FCC1 connector pins 3 and 4 via nets UART3_TX_FCC and UART3_RX_FCC.
anomalies.expected: VCAP pins should be decoupled to GND with capacitors (e.g., 2.2uF) and must not be connected to external connectors.
anomalies.impact: The internal core regulator of FCC1 is shorted to an external UART connector, likely causing malfunction or permanent damage.

anomalies.observed: HSE1 crystal is connected to FCC1 pins 5 (PE6) and 37 (PE7) via HSE_IN_FCC and HSE_OUT_FCC. The actual HSE pins PH0 (pin 12) and PH1 (pin 13) are connected to C14 and VREF+_FCC respectively.
anomalies.expected: HSE crystal should connect to HSE_IN (PH0, pin 12) and HSE_OUT (PH1, pin 13).
anomalies.impact: FCC1 will not receive a clock from the HSE crystal, preventing the MCU from operating.

anomalies.observed: NAVC1 VSS pins 18 and 63 are connected only to each other on net Net-(NAVC1-VSS-Pad18), which is not GND. VSSA pin 12 is unconnected.
anomalies.expected: All VSS and VSSA pins should be connected to GND.
anomalies.impact: NAVC1 has no ground reference, so it cannot function.
